about: After-data exploratory two-case A1 PC5/PC4 repair screen. S8 uses a separate attacker-owned Slack member message; W34 attacks Mark's native recipe vector against identical Emma-owned benign search background. Both cases require independent native-GT validation. This file has only a bounded smoke stage; no full-stage auto-continuation. The v1 stage file and historical results remain frozen.
historical_boundary: The first four-case G1 screen is a separate experiment; this v2 fixture screen cannot be pooled with its episodes or used to relabel historical H1/H2 or G1 results.
price_basis: DeepSeek official https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ verified 2026-10-10, peak uncached deepseek-flash input USD 0.30/M and output USD 1.20/M. Guard charges the conservative peak/no-cache snapshot; receipt is an estimate, not invoice.
